entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex... I hope you can help. I'm trying to return something, and I'm just so confused by the website. I bought this helmet...
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's... VF-8675309. I just don't understand the process. It all seems very complicated.
No problem at all, I'm happy to walk you through it. I see the order here for the Aero-Shield Helmet. Can you tell me, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. The color just wasn't what I expected from the photos online. The box is still completely unopened. I haven't even touched it. Can't you just help me? I'm worried I waited too long.
I understand. So it's a preference issue with the color, not a defect with the helmet itself. Your safety is our top priority, so I just wanted to make sure there wasn't a functional problem.
Yes, that's right. No safety issue, I just don't like the color. I'd like to send it back if I can.
Okay, let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment please... Alright, I see the delivery date was 83 days ago.
Oh no. Is that bad? I knew I should have called sooner. This is so overwhelming.

Not at all! You're well within our policy. VeloFit offers a 90-day return window for standard items. Since it's within that timeframe and the box is unopened, you are perfectly eligible for a full refund.
Really? Oh, that's wonderful! Thank you! I was so worried I had missed my chance.

You're very welcome. I've just processed that return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account right now. Just print it out, attach it to the original package, and you can drop it off at any mail depot.
That's so easy. Thank you so much for your help, Alex.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. You've been a great help.
Glad to hear it. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
